description: Attachment check for the 1885 Minnesota State Census ARK (HOLE-003) that source-evaluation has just classified as misattributed to Christian P. Hole. It comes back attached to KD96-WX7 as well — a same-name man in Otter Tail County — which is the evidence that turns 'this record is not about him' into 'this record belongs to that other Christian Hole'. The skill's body requires this call before it recommends a detach, so that the recommendation names where the record actually belongs instead of merely asserting it does not belong here. The `~` uris predicate matches whatever ARK form the skill passes.
